text.arabic_uthmani: أَيَطْمَعُ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍۢ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُدْخَلَ جَنَّةَ نَعِيمٍۢ

words.gloss_range: rhetorically challenged coveting or overreaching desire, not neutral wishing
words.root_gloss_range: desire, aspiration, and greedy longing; the local interrogative selects the rebuking overreach side of the range
words.prose: {{ar:أَيَطْمَعُ}} ({{tr:ʾa-yaṭmaʿu}}) opens with the question particle fused directly to the coveting verb, so the ayah begins by challenging desire itself. The root can cover aspiration, but the rhetorical frame and the following admission clause make the local force sharper: each claimant is pictured as reaching for what is not his to secure. This first word also governs the whole two-beat structure: active coveting in the first beat reaches toward a passive, unrealized admission in the second, and the shared y-imperfect opening makes that voice reversal audible. The initial glottal catch and the heavy coveting texture of the emphatic and pharyngeal consonants make the rebuke arrive before the subject is fully named, turning the visible factional rush of 70:36-37 into an exposed inner motive.

topics.headline: question form rebukes coveting
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the opening is not asking for information but placing the desire for admission under immediate rebuke.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify an interrogative hamza on the imperfect verb, and the discourse support marks the question as a rhetorical challenge.

topics.headline: desire narrowed to overreach
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that {{ar:ط م ع}} ({{tr:ṭ-m-ʿ}}) is not neutral hope here; the context turns aspiration into presumptuous appetite.
topics.reason: The broad root range includes hope and desire, but the local rhetorical denial and the coveted paradise-entry content narrow the force to overreaching desire.

topics.headline: fused opening makes rebuke audible
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the abrupt recited opening as a surface collision between interrogation and desire.
topics.reason: The local surface joins the interrogative onset to the imperfect verb, so the sound-form observation is anchored in the actual word.

topics.headline: active desire reaches toward passive admission
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the structural irony: human activity appears as coveting, while the wanted outcome is framed as admission received from beyond the claimant.
topics.reason: The main verb governs the following {{ar:أَنْ}} ({{tr:ʾan}}) clause, and the second verb is passive, licensing the active-versus-passive contrast.

topics.headline: factional display becomes inner motive
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the prior outward rushing scene in 70:36-37 is recast as inward coveting for admission.
topics.reason: The root is uncommon and locally joins the universal subject and admission object, while the boundary rows tie the question back to the preceding group scene.

words.gloss_range: distributive every, functioning as the nominative subject in construct with an indefinite singular person
words.root_gloss_range: totality, entirety, and exhaustive scope; locally distributive rather than merely collective

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: indefinite singular person governed by the distributive quantifier
partitive phrase restricting the distributive subject to the antecedent group

words.prose: {{ar:كُلُّ}} ({{tr:kullu}}) makes the rebuke exhaustive but not vague. In construct with {{ar:ٱمْرِئٍ}} ({{tr:mriʾin}}), it distributes the question one person at a time, so the prior crowd is not allowed to hide inside a collective posture. Its nominative subject role assigns coveting to each claimant, and its placement before {{ar:مِّنْهُمْ}} ({{tr:minhum}}) lets totality be heard first before the group boundary tightens. The word therefore universalizes the presumption only within the targeted group, not over all humanity. Because this totalizing word can stand in entry and garden-reward fields, the ayah strains that familiar reward language by asking whether every claimant expects admission.

topics.headline: each person singled out
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah atomizes the crowd into each individual claimant rather than addressing an undifferentiated mass.
topics.reason: The word is a nominative construct head followed by an indefinite singular dependent, the local shape for distributive totality.

topics.headline: totality carries the subject slot
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that exhaustive scope is not ornamental; it is the grammatical subject of the coveting predicate.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies {{ar:كُلُّ}} ({{tr:kullu}}) as the explicit subject of {{ar:أَيَطْمَعُ}} ({{tr:ʾa-yaṭmaʿu}}).

topics.headline: totality bounded by among them
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the rhetorical pressure of every single one, then the limit that this exhaustiveness is inside the referenced group.
topics.reason: The following partitive phrase restricts the universal subject to the antecedent group, while the question keeps the force rebuking.

topics.headline: every-person idiom dissolves factions
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a compact accountability idiom that converts the factional scene of 70:36-37 into personal expectation.
topics.reason: The supplied profiles show a strong {{ar:ك ل ل}} ({{tr:k-l-l}}) plus {{ar:م ر أ}} ({{tr:m-r-ʾ}}) accountability pattern, and the boundary rows make that local transition explicit.

topics.headline: universal reward language inverted
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that language able to pair with entry and garden reward is used here to universalize presumptuous expectation rather than promise.
topics.reason: The co-occurrence rows survive as recurrence pressure, but the local rhetorical question makes the formulaic field an inversion of entitlement.

words.gloss_range: an indefinite singular person governed by every, making the claimant individually accountable
words.root_gloss_range: personhood and man/person language, with broader family pressures of integrity and reflection kept secondary

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: distributive quantifier governing the person noun

words.prose: {{ar:ٱمْرِئٍۢ}} ({{tr:mriʾin}}) completes the distributive subject by giving {{ar:كُلُّ}} ({{tr:kullu}}) one person at a time to range over. Its genitive case marks it as the governed unit of totality, while its indefinite singular form keeps the class open: any person among them is caught by the question. The lexical choice names a human individual rather than a faction, so the rebuke becomes personal accountability in a recurring every-person idiom. Broader family notes about wholeness or reflection can color that accountability, but the local sense remains the person-word in a construct phrase, not a separate mirror or integrity claim. Its final tanwīn also anticipates the closing bliss word, audibly setting the indefinite claimant against the indefinite reward he covets.

topics.headline: one person at a time
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the syntax inspects each claimant individually rather than leaving the group as a plural mass.
topics.reason: QAC marks the noun as genitive and indefinite, and attachment evidence makes it the complement of {{ar:كُلُّ}} ({{tr:kullu}}).

topics.headline: indefinite claimant class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that no named individual is singled out; the indefinite form leaves the claimant class open within the targeted group.
topics.reason: The tanwīn and indefinite singular form support an open-class reading, while {{ar:مِّنْهُمْ}} ({{tr:minhum}}) later bounds that class.

topics.headline: human person, not faction label
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the rebuke landing on a human individual rather than on an abstract party name.
topics.reason: The lexical evidence supports person/man language, and local grammar uses the noun as the human unit governed by totality.

topics.headline: integrity and reflection kept as color
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a possible personhood field of wholeness and self-recognition, while the local grammar keeps the selected sense as person.
topics.reason: Derivative links can enrich the moral pressure, but the local word is the concrete person noun, so mirror and wholesome senses cannot replace the selected meaning.

topics.headline: person between totality and bliss
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the claimant positioned between exhaustive scope and the final bliss he covets, with an audible tanwīn link to the close.
topics.reason: The word is placed between {{ar:كُلُّ}} ({{tr:kullu}}) and {{ar:مِّنْهُمْ}} ({{tr:minhum}}), and its tanwīn corresponds to the closing indefinite qualifier.

topics.headline: person-word in accountability contexts
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the every-person wording belongs to a wider accountability pattern, not a casual count of bodies.
topics.reason: The contextual profiles preserve the recurring {{ar:ك ل ل}} ({{tr:k-l-l}}) plus {{ar:م ر أ}} ({{tr:m-r-ʾ}}) relation, while the local construction activates it in a rebuking question.

words.gloss_range: partitive preposition plus third masculine plural suffix, restricting each person to the antecedent group
words.prose: {{ar:مِّنْهُمْ}} ({{tr:minhum}}) prevents the universal wording from becoming a statement about every human being. The preposition and suffix bind each person to the antecedent group from 70:36-37, so the exhaustiveness of {{ar:كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍ}} ({{tr:kullu mriʾin}}) is bounded inside them. Because the limiter comes after the distributive phrase, the listener first feels the pressure of every person and then hears the scope close around the specific group. The compact attached suffix also keeps the prior group audible at the hinge before the desired admission clause, with the m/n sounds carrying the phrase into the next particle.

topics.headline: suffix routes back to prior group
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the rebuke remains tied to the same group described in 70:36-37 rather than becoming a detached maxim.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence identifies the suffix referent as the nearby disbelieving group from the prior context.

topics.headline: universal scope bounded within them
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that every means every one among them, not every human without restriction.
topics.reason: The prepositional phrase is licensed as a partitive complement to the distributive subject phrase.

topics.headline: preposition and suffix fuse
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the restriction carried in a compact bound phrase rather than a separate explanatory clause.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence parse the word as preposition plus pronoun suffix governed in one prepositional phrase.

topics.headline: limiter lands after totality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the order: exhaustive individual scope is heard first, then the phrase narrows it and turns toward the admission clause.
topics.reason: The word follows the distributive subject and precedes {{ar:أَنْ}} ({{tr:ʾan}}), so the claimed hinge effect matches the local order.

words.gloss_range: subjunctive/content particle introducing the unrealized admission clause coveted by the subject

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: subjunctive passive admission verb governed by the particle
garden-of-bliss destination phrase governed by the passive admission verb

words.prose: {{ar:أَنْ}} ({{tr:ʾan}}) is the hinge from who covets to what is coveted. It governs {{ar:يُدْخَلَ}} ({{tr:yudkhala}}) and extends over {{ar:جَنَّةَ نَعِيمٍ}} ({{tr:jannata naʿīmin}}), packaging the whole paradise-entry event as the content of desire. Because the following verb is subjunctive under this particle, the entry is not asserted as happening; it remains an unrealized outcome presumed by the claimants, the result toward which coveting points but not an independent purpose clause. Its brevity makes the turn sharp: one small particle opens the entire object clause, and the nasal close moving into the y-onset of the passive verb makes the pivot audible.

topics.headline: whole entry phrase becomes coveted content
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the object of coveting is not left vague; it is the whole event of being admitted to a garden of bliss.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the {{ar:أَنْ}} ({{tr:ʾan}}) clause the content complement of {{ar:أَيَطْمَعُ}} ({{tr:ʾa-yaṭmaʿu}}).

topics.headline: entry remains unrealized
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that admission is grammatically subordinated as desired content, not asserted as an achieved fact.
topics.reason: QAC marks {{ar:أَنْ}} ({{tr:ʾan}}) as a subjunctive particle and {{ar:يُدْخَلَ}} ({{tr:yudkhala}}) as subjunctive under its scope.

topics.headline: desired outcome, not present state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices admission as the outcome toward which coveting points, while local syntax keeps it a content complement rather than an independent purpose clause.
topics.reason: The particle can bear purpose/result pressure, but the local attachment identifies it specifically as the content complement of the desire verb.

topics.headline: short particle turns the clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the concise surface hinge where the ayah turns from subject diagnosis to the admission event.
topics.reason: The single particle stands between the partitive subject phrase and the passive verb, matching the claimed hinge function.

words.gloss_range: subjunctive passive admission into a destination, with the claimant as recipient rather than self-entering agent
words.root_gloss_range: entering, admission, inside/outside transition, and related inner-defect/intruder imagery; local grammar selects passive admission

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: subjunctive particle introducing the desired admission clause
singular person tracked by the third masculine singular passive verb
accusative garden destination complement of the passive verb

words.prose: {{ar:يُدْخَلَ}} ({{tr:yudkhala}}) turns the desired object into a gatekeeping event. Under {{ar:أَنْ}} ({{tr:ʾan}}), it remains non-actual, and in the passive it makes the claimant the one admitted rather than the one who secures entry. The third masculine singular tracks each {{ar:ٱمْرِئٍ}} ({{tr:mriʾin}}), keeping admission person-by-person, while the following {{ar:جَنَّةَ}} ({{tr:jannata}}) names the destination. The accepted active variant exposes the same pressure point, but the local recited passive keeps the admitter unnamed and makes granted access the issue; it also reaches the paradise-admission meaning without the more usual explicit causative admission formula. Broader {{ar:د خ ل}} ({{tr:d-kh-l}}) images of inside movement, belonging, and inner defect sharpen the irony only as secondary color. The stop-fricative-liquid movement of the root sounds suits threshold passage, and the passive shape remains distributionally marked against more active entry patterns.

topics.headline: admission received, not seized
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the desired entry depends on admission granted from beyond the claimant, not on the claimant's own agency.
topics.reason: QAC marks the verb as passive, and attachment evidence identifies the claimant as the passive subject of the admission event.

topics.headline: desired entry remains non-actual
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verse never asserts admission; the entry is syntactically kept inside coveted content.
topics.reason: The verb is governed by the preceding subjunctive particle, so the admission clause remains subordinate to coveting.

topics.headline: passive verb still names a destination
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the passive does not stay abstract; it moves the claimant toward a named garden destination.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence says {{ar:جَنَّةَ}} ({{tr:jannata}}) remains the accusative complement of the passive verb.

topics.headline: singular admission tracks each claimant
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the passive admission remains distributive, matching each person rather than the plural group suffix.
topics.reason: The verb is third masculine singular, aligning with the singular person-word governed by {{ar:كُلُّ}} ({{tr:kullu}}).

topics.headline: variant exposes agency pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the agency fork between entering and being admitted, while the local canonical surface keeps the passive admission reading in control.
topics.reason: The accepted active reading is useful contrast, but the local surface is passive Form I and cannot be treated as active self-entry.

topics.headline: garden-entry formula under denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a familiar paradise-entry pairing being placed inside a rebuking question rather than a promise.
topics.reason: The local verb takes the garden noun as its complement, and the supplied co-occurrence rows identify the pair as a strong paradise-entry formula.

topics.headline: desire pivots into gatekeeping
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah pivot from active appetite to a passive admission whose gate is outside the claimant's control.
topics.reason: The first verb is active and the second verb is passive inside the complement clause, giving the structural contrast a direct grammatical basis.

topics.headline: inside movement and inner defect as color
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the irony of claimants wanting inside access while the root family can evoke alien entry or inner defect, with passive admission remaining the selected local sense.
topics.reason: Derivative imagery can sharpen the admission scene, but local grammar selects entry/admission and does not activate corruption as the primary sense.

topics.headline: marked passive surface
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the passive admission shape as marked in form and sound, not a plain active entrance verb.
topics.reason: The rows concern the recited passive surface and supplied distributional markedness, both anchored in the local verb form.

words.gloss_range: an accusative singular indefinite construct garden/paradise destination defined by bliss
words.root_gloss_range: garden, covering, concealment, protected interior, and related hiddenness branches; locally the noun selects the paradise garden destination

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: passive admission verb governing the garden destination
genitive bliss qualifier completing the construct garden phrase

words.prose: {{ar:جَنَّةَ}} ({{tr:jannata}}) is the named destination of the passive admission, not a possessed object the claimant already owns. Its accusative case follows {{ar:يُدْخَلَ}} ({{tr:yudkhala}}) as the place entered, and its immediate placement after the verb makes the coveted destination land without delay. Its construct form requires {{ar:نَعِيمٍ}} ({{tr:naʿīmin}}) to complete the phrase as a garden of bliss. The singular indefinite shape avoids sounding like a claim on a familiar definite paradise and narrows the desire into one bliss-garden phrase. The {{ar:ج ن ن}} ({{tr:j-n-n}}) hidden-enclosure field remains useful: the shield, hidden-interior, and covering images make the desired reward an inside, protected realm into which one must be admitted. The same-surah return from the promised gardens of 70:35 sharpens the contrast between promised reward and presumptuous access.

topics.headline: garden as destination of admission
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices paradise as the destination into which admission is sought, not an object already possessed.
topics.reason: QAC marks the noun accusative, and attachment evidence makes it the complement of the passive entry verb.

topics.headline: garden bound to bliss
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the garden is defined by bliss through construct grammar rather than merely accompanied by a separate blessing.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies {{ar:نَعِيمٍ}} ({{tr:naʿīmin}}) as the genitive complement of {{ar:جَنَّةَ}} ({{tr:jannata}}).

topics.headline: one indefinite garden phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the wording presents a desired garden of bliss rather than a definite entitlement or plural inventory.
topics.reason: The surface is singular, indefinite, and construct before the genitive qualifier.

topics.headline: garden as protected hidden interior
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the garden as an enclosed and protected inside space, while the local sense remains paradise garden rather than every concealment derivative.
topics.reason: The root family supports hiddenness and covering imagery, but local grammar selects the concrete paradise-garden noun.

topics.headline: formulaic reward language denied
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices dense paradise formula language placed under rhetorical denial rather than straightforward promise.
topics.reason: The word links the entry verb and bliss qualifier, and supplied co-occurrence rows identify both formula fields.

topics.headline: return from promised gardens
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the garden root returning after the promised gardens of 70:35, now as the presumptuous object of the disbelievers' desire.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give the concrete same-surah contrast, and the local singular phrase differs from the earlier plural reward wording.

topics.headline: concealment root made into place
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the root's covering imagery is realized as a concrete place that can be entered.
topics.reason: QAC tags the word as a concrete noun, and the local syntax treats it as the destination complement.

words.gloss_range: genitive indefinite bliss-state qualifier completing the construct garden phrase
words.root_gloss_range: softness, ease, favor, material prosperity, and sustained bliss; locally the selected form is a bliss-state quality

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: construct garden noun qualified by the bliss noun

words.prose: {{ar:نَعِيمٍۢ}} ({{tr:naʿīmin}}) closes the ayah by naming the quality of the desired garden. Its genitive case locks it to {{ar:جَنَّةَ}} ({{tr:jannata}}) as a qualifier, not a second object of entry, and its indefinite form leaves the bliss expansive rather than itemized. The form selects a sustained bliss-state rather than a countable favor, though the {{ar:ن ع م}} ({{tr:n-ʿ-m}}) family of softness, bestowed favor, and material abundance gives that state tactile warmth and grantedness. The word chiefly completes the garden-bliss collocation rather than forming the main entry formula on its own, and that recognizable paradise descriptor appears across the supplied formula field (5:65, 10:9, 22:56, 26:85, 31:8, 37:43, 56:12, 56:89, 68:34). As the final word, it makes the last semantic landing the reward they presume, while its tanwīn and internal -in cadence answer the earlier indefinite person and maintain the nasal sound thread from 70:37 into the close.

topics.headline: bliss qualifies the garden
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices bliss as the defining quality of the garden, not a second thing entered or possessed.
topics.reason: QAC marks the noun genitive, and attachment evidence makes it the genitive complement of {{ar:جَنَّةَ}} ({{tr:jannata}}).

topics.headline: open-ended bliss quality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the bliss left qualitative and expansive rather than delimited as a known object.
topics.reason: The word is indefinite genitive and functions as a quality of the construct head.

topics.headline: state, not countable favor
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the phrase naming a continuing bliss-state rather than an itemized favor.
topics.reason: The lexical and form evidence distinguish {{ar:نَعِيمٍ}} ({{tr:naʿīmin}}) from countable favor terms in the same root family.

topics.headline: softness and favor color the bliss
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the bliss as experientially gentle and bestowed, while local grammar keeps {{ar:نَعِيمٍ}} ({{tr:naʿīmin}}) as the selected bliss-state noun.
topics.reason: The broader root family supports softness, favor, and material ease, but those branches color rather than replace the local bliss-state sense.

topics.headline: formulaic garden-of-bliss close
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a recognizable paradise formula made the coveted object under denial rather than a promise.
topics.reason: The supplied co-occurrence rows identify the garden-bliss phrase as formulaic, and local grammar binds the two nouns directly.

topics.headline: bliss is the final landing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah ending not on the claimant but on the bliss being presumed after the challenge of 70:36-37.
topics.reason: The word is the final word of the clause and completes the desired admission phrase.

topics.headline: cadence links claimant and bliss
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the sound link between the indefinite claimant and the final indefinite bliss quality.
topics.reason: Both the person noun and final bliss noun bear the relevant indefinite cadence, and the CRITICAL rows tie the sound to subject and closure positions.

topics.headline: nasal ending continues the boundary sound
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the closing sound maintaining continuity with the nasal ending of 70:37 while the scene shifts to coveted bliss.
topics.reason: The row gives the concrete boundary reference to 70:37, and the local final word supplies the nasal close.

topics.headline: works through garden more than entry
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that {{ar:نَعِيمٍ}} ({{tr:naʿīmin}}) chiefly completes the garden collocation rather than forming the main entry formula on its own.
topics.reason: The supplied relation to entry is weaker than the garden pairing, and local grammar makes bliss the genitive qualifier of the garden noun.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The interrogative binds يطمع to the passive يُدخل and to جنة نعيم.
baseline_models.mechanism: Desire points toward a transition whose agent is withheld: the person hopes to be caused to cross into a tree-covered enclosure characterized as bestowed well-being. The passive admission makes granted access, not appetite, decisive.

activation_trace.role: Heartfelt desire and hope supply the claimant's pull toward the destination without supplying access to it.
Entry supplies the boundary crossing, while the passive form assigns that crossing to an unexpressed admitting agent.
The tree-covered garden supplies an enclosed destination rather than an abstract reward.
Pleasant well-being as bestowed favor makes bliss a gift received rather than a possession seized.

changed_reading.after: Each person hopes an admitting agency will carry him across a boundary into bestowed well-being, but desire itself supplies no access.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: كل امرئ منهم distributes the interrogated hope over singular persons drawn from a plurality.
baseline_models.mechanism: Totality scopes a singular human noun: the ayah does not leave desire at the level of a vague crowd but tests the same expectation one claimant at a time. منهم keeps each singular claim attached to the group from which it is extracted.

activation_trace.role: Totality and completeness distribute the questioned expectation across every member.
The individual person turns a collective posture into separately accountable personal claims.
Desire supplies the repeated inward expectation assigned to each person.

changed_reading.before: The crowd generally hopes for admission.
changed_reading.after: The question disaggregates the crowd and challenges a blanket presumption reproduced privately by every member.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The roots of يطمع, كل, and نعيم can align desire, total distribution, and bestowed bounty.
baseline_models.mechanism: A form-distant branch of طمع names soldiers' allotments. Held as an image rather than a gloss of the verb, it makes the universal hope resemble an expectation that bliss is pay due to every claimant.

activation_trace.role: The stipend branch contributes the form-distant image of desire recast as expected allotment.
Totality distributes the imagined allotment without exception across the claimant group.
Bestowed bounty supplies what the claimant imagines as automatically due.

changed_reading.before: Every person entertains a strong wish for bliss.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, every person behaves as though bestowed bliss were a universal allotment entered on his account.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier wish tries to exchange kin and then everyone else for rescue; the focus wish seeks direct admission for each self. Read together, the passive entry becomes the last imagined self-exemption after substitution has failed.

activation_trace.role: Wishing for an outcome supplies the earlier desperate desire that the focus later individualizes.
Making one thing a ransom for another supplies the failed substitution mechanism.
Escape by separation supplies the rescue the proposed exchange is supposed to cause.
Heartfelt hope carries the rescue-seeking posture into the focus question.
The singular person identifies the beneficiary who now seeks admission for himself.
Caused entry replaces ransom as the imagined route to safety.

structural_cues: 70:10-14 moves from failed mutual concern through offered kin and all the earth as ransom to hoped-for rescue; 70:38 returns to one person drawn from a plurality.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the wish-ransom-rescue sequence and the later each-person desire; I infer a shift from substituting others to seeking one's own exempting admission. Alternatively, the two wishes may be parallel forms of desperation rather than stages of one strategy.

changed_reading.before: The ayah challenges an unsupported hope for paradise.
changed_reading.after: It also challenges a rescue logic in which each self, after imagining others as exchangeable, still expects to be admitted as the spared beneficiary.

context_deltas.mechanism: Gathering, sealing into a container, and withholding good form an acquisitive reflex. The same reflex then scripts the garden as one more good to be acquired inwardly for oneself, exposing the asymmetry between refusing outward transfer and expecting inward admission.

activation_trace.role: Gathering dispersed things into one possession supplies the acquisitive first step.
Putting something into a container supplies retention and closure after gathering.
Holding the hand back from giving supplies the blocked outward movement of good.
Desire turns the same possessive orientation toward the garden.
Passive entry supplies the inward movement the withholder expects for himself.
Bestowed good is the very kind of outward benefit the earlier human type blocks.

structural_cues: 70:18 places gathering and containing in immediate sequence; 70:19-21 generalizes an agitated human reflex and culminates in withholding good.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gather-contain-withhold and the later desire for admission; I infer that one possessive habit governs both sequences, reversing outward generosity into demanded inward access. Alternatively, the focus may criticize presumption without specifically recalling hoarding.

changed_reading.before: The claimant merely wants a desirable destination.
changed_reading.after: The claimant expects to receive and contain bestowed good while belonging to the human pattern that contains good and refuses to release it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context locates a recognized, bounded right inside wealth and directs it toward the requester and the deprived. That real allocation sharpens the focus's form-distant stipend image into a category error: blanket entitlement to bliss is imagined by persons whose relevant test is whether they recognize another's due share.

activation_trace.role: Possessed wealth supplies the finite fund within which an actual allocation is located.
A specific right owned by its holder supplies bounded entitlement rather than indiscriminate expectation.
Knowledge as disclosure makes the right recognized and determinate rather than imagined.
Request and asking identify one recipient toward whom the known right must move.
Deprivation and loss of the sought thing identify the other recipient of the allocation.
The stipend branch converts desire into an exploratory expectation of pay due.
Totality makes that imagined entitlement blanket rather than bounded.
Bestowed favor supplies the bounty incorrectly treated as automatic compensation.

structural_cues: 70:24-25 forms one compact allocation: a known right in wealth is for the requester and the deprived.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an actual bounded right and a universal desire for bestowed bliss; I use the focus's stipend branch to infer a contrast between administered obligation and imagined entitlement. Alternatively, the stipend image may be only a lexical echo and not a live legal-economic mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Every person hopes to receive bliss.
changed_reading.after: Every person is exposed as treating bliss like a universal credit while the context defines entitlement through a concrete right owed outward to particular others.

context_deltas.mechanism: A sustained chain of practice, obligation, and guarding resolves in gardens plus honor before the focus asks about admission. Garden is therefore not an unqualified place available to appetite; it is the spatial outcome of a maintained relation whose social-moral quality is honor.

activation_trace.role: Specific worship opens the sustained practice sequence that precedes the garden outcome.
Obligatory fixed entitlement supplies outward responsibility within that practice sequence.
Maintaining and adhering to an obligation closes the sequence with durable practice.
The tree-covered gardens supply the explicit destination reached by the preceding description.
Commendable honor and generosity supply the relational status enjoyed there.
Bare desire is tested against the sustained sequence that precedes it.
Bestowed well-being names the hoped condition but does not replace the maintained relation.

structural_cues: 70:22-34 is a linked relative-clause sequence; 70:35 resolves it with gardens and honor, while 70:36-38 pivots to a contrasting group and its expectation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the descriptive chain and its garden-honor resolution; I infer that the sequence functions as a formation or eligibility contrast to bare appetite. Alternatively, it may describe two populations without specifying a causal admission test.

changed_reading.before: Garden admission is a desired destination considered by itself.
changed_reading.after: Garden and bliss are the culmination of maintained worship, obligation, and guarding, so the question contrasts formed honor with ungrounded appetite.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate context arranges a converging crowd by facing, forward haste, and right-left flanks. كل امرئ then breaks that spatial mass into singular claimants: bodily convergence does not create collective access, and each member privately carries the same presumption.

activation_trace.role: Face-to-face orientation supplies the crowd's directed convergence before the question.
Hastening forward adds kinetic pressure to the converging arrangement.
The right-hand direction supplies one organized flank of the crowd.
The left-hand direction supplies the opposing flank and completes the encircled geometry.
Totality distributes the question through every body in the spatial mass.
The singular person makes each crowd member individually carry the admission claim.

structural_cues: The plural bodies and side-grouping of 70:36-37 switch abruptly to the distributive singular كل امرئ in 70:38.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies converging spatial cues and the subsequent distributive singular; I infer that the syntax exposes a crowd as many replicated private claims rather than one qualified body. Alternatively, the singular may simply generalize without criticizing crowd dynamics.

changed_reading.before: Every individual independently hopes for entry.
changed_reading.after: A physically convergent crowd is verbally disassembled, showing that proximity, speed, and group formation cannot pool into admission for any one member.

context_deltas.mechanism: The answer relocates agency from the desiring person to the one who creates, has effective capacity, can substitute a better population, and cannot be outstripped. The passive admission is thus controlled by the same agency before which each claimant is contingent and replaceable.

activation_trace.role: Origination and bringing into existence supply the claimant's dependence on a prior agent.
Effective capacity reaching action and control supplies the power behind admission or refusal.
One thing standing in another's place supplies the population-replacement mechanism.
Excellence and selection supply the comparative standard for the proposed replacement.
Escaping beyond a pursuer supplies the possibility explicitly denied to the claimants.
Passive entry becomes one operation within the creator's effective control.
Each person is recast from presumed beneficiary to contingent created instance.

structural_cues: 70:39 begins with a direct negation immediately after the question; 70:40-41 expands from creation to cosmic lordship, capacity, replacement, and non-evasion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies negation, creation, capacity, replacement, and non-evasion; I infer that the unexpressed agent of passive admission is the same sovereign agent, so entitlement collapses under creaturely replaceability. Alternatively, the denial may target this crowd specifically rather than every form of hope.

changed_reading.before: Applicants await a decision about entry.
changed_reading.after: Created and replaceable persons presume upon an admission power held entirely by an agent they can neither constrain nor outrun.

context_deltas.mechanism: The hoped motion is passive entry into an enclosed good; the disclosed motion is exit from graves followed by rapid movement toward an erected marker. This spatial reversal replaces elective inward reception with compelled outward exposure and directed assembly.

activation_trace.role: Passage to the outside supplies the exact directional counter-motion to hoped entry.
The grave supplies the enclosing origin from which the persons actually emerge.
Speed opposed to slowness supplies urgency in the disclosed movement.
An erected boundary marker supplies the visible target organizing the rush.
Entry supplies the inward motion whose direction and voluntariness are reversed.
Hope supplies the imagined motion displaced by the disclosed one.

structural_cues: The branchless root و ف ض at 70:43 is used only structurally: يُوفضون reinforces rapid directed movement toward the marker and is not branch-cited.
The passive يُدخل in 70:38 and plural active يخرجون in 70:43 reverse both direction and how the moving persons appear grammatically.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed entry and exit, a grave origin, speed, and a target marker; I infer a deliberate spatial reversal from imagined inward admission to compelled outward summons. Alternatively, these may be successive eschatological scenes rather than one contrastive motion model.

changed_reading.before: Each person imagines being moved inward into a garden.
changed_reading.after: The context replaces that wished-for inward crossing with outward emergence from enclosure and a hurried, exposed movement toward an assigned marker.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's hoped well-being stands between two status endpoints: persons in gardens are honored, whereas the appointed promised day ends with lowered eyes and disgrace covering the crowd. The question is therefore about which status will be bestowed or imposed, not location alone.

activation_trace.role: Commendable honor supplies the positive social status paired with gardens.
A promise fixed to a time or place supplies the authorized appointment that replaces subjective expectation.
Lowering and submission supply the bodily status opposed to honor.
Overtaking and overpowering supply the imposed movement by which disgrace covers them.
Brokenness under compulsion supplies the negative status that answers presumptive honor.
Bestowed well-being supplies the positive condition each claimant expects.
Enticement and induced expectation distinguish subjective hope from an authorized promise.

structural_cues: Garden-honor at 70:35 precedes the focus, while the repeated promised-day formula at 70:42 and 70:44 closes on humbled eyes and covering disgrace.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies honor before the question and an appointed humiliation after it; I infer that the focus contrasts self-induced expectation with the status actually assigned at the promised time. Alternatively, the framing may contrast populations without making promise and desire competing authorizations.

changed_reading.before: The claimant expects a pleasant place.
changed_reading.after: The claimant expects bestowed honor, but the authorized appointment discloses an imposed status of lowered, overpowered disgrace instead.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it links two different semantic domains through the image of covering. It remains anchored by the immediate description at 70:36 and the focus root of جنة, but downstream prose should present it only as a lexical-material irony, never as an equation of disbelief with garden.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The people described immediately before the focus by كفر seek جنة, whose root also carries covering and concealment.

activation_trace.role: Concealing truth supplies the harmful covering practiced by the claimant group.
Covering from perception supplies the shared material image in the desired destination.
The tree-covered garden turns concealment into the beneficial shelter they seek.

changed_reading.before: Those who conceal truth nevertheless want a garden.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, those marked by a destructive covering presume upon admission into a beneficial covering, producing a material irony of concealment and shelter.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the decoy is a nominal, form-distant branch while the focus uses the ordinary verb of desire. The image remains anchored in طمع and the ayah's passive entry into an enclosure; downstream prose should call it a decoy analogy and must not translate يطمع as being trapped or imply a hidden agent's motive.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The sequence يطمع ... يُدخل جنة joins desire, caused entry, and an enclosed destination.

activation_trace.role: The decoy bird placed inside a net supplies a form-distant image of attraction organized around an enclosure.
Caused entry supplies the movement toward the attractive enclosure without granting the desirer control.
The tree-covered garden supplies the bounded attractive space around which desire gathers.

changed_reading.before: The garden is simply the object of desire.
changed_reading.after: As a contained lexical analogy, the attractive enclosure also exposes how desire can draw a claimant toward a scene whose access and outcome he does not control.

strongest_changes: The passive admission became a question of agency: created and replaceable claimants cannot convert appetite into granted access.
The ethical sequence and its garden-honor result changed paradise from a free-standing prize into the outcome of maintained worship, outward obligation, and guarding.
The final exit from graves reversed hoped inward entry into compelled outward exposure and rapid directed assembly.
The hoarding and known-right sequences recast universal hope as an asymmetry between demanded inward benefit and blocked outward benefit.
summary.what_was_special: The focus compresses appetite, distributive individuality, passive boundary crossing, enclosure, and bestowed ease into one question. Context repeatedly changes the same compact mechanism by altering agency, entitlement, motion, and status without requiring one final interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The stipend and decoy activations depend on form-distant branches and should remain explicit lexical analogies.
The formation or eligibility arrow inferred from 70:22-35 is stronger than a mere contrast but is not grammatically stated as a causal rule.
The entry-exit reversal may be deliberate spatial counterpoint or simply the juxtaposition of successive eschatological scenes.
The ransom sequence may explain the later self-admission wish, or both may independently express desperation and presumption.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Desire mistakes proximity to the message for entitlement to entry.** *Yaṭmaʿu* activates **ط م ع, B001, “heartfelt desire and hope,”** while the preceding crowd stands spatially near the addressee and the passive *yudkhala* imagines admission performed for each person. I infer that they convert attendance into expected access without adopting the practices of 70:22–34. The question therefore targets unsupported entitlement, not hope as such.

2. **The garden can function as a decoy for unexamined appetite.** **ط م ع, B005, “decoy bird in a net,”** is a dormant image activated by the sequence from crowding to individual desire and then abrupt *kallā* (70:39). Exploratorily, I infer that the desired image draws out and reveals their assumption rather than validating it. The ayah reads as diagnostic elicitation: what they reach for exposes how they reason.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The abrupt creation argument in 70:39 corrected hope into entitlement, while replacement in 70:41 removed any assumption of irreplaceable status. Those later ayat made the decoy branch exploratory but structurally productive.

baseline.text: Onlardan her biri nimet bahçesine sokulmayı mı umuyor?

findings.text: Mesaja yakın durmak ve kalabalığa katılmak, bahçeye alınma yetkisi vermez; toplu beklenti, tek tek dayanaksız kişisel hak iddialarına ayrılır.
Bahçe, yalnız arzulanan nimet değil, giriş yetkisi başkasına ait korunan bir iyilik alanıdır; istek ile izin arasındaki farkı sınırı görünür kılar.
Arzulanan bahçe imgesi bir tuzak yemi gibi, kişilerin gizli hak edilmişlik varsayımını dışarı çıkarıp teşhis edebilir.
Pasif biçimde bahçeye alınma arzusu, ileride mezarlardan başka bir iradenin programına göre çıkarılmalarıyla tersine çevrilir.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A surface may shelter or disguise an interior, but wear, opening, and color eventually disclose what the cover carried.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Night-cover, wrap, mosquito tent, worn cloth, concealed sword, inner corruption, dyed sign, black raven, and whitening hair form a disclosure process.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Concealed interior and disguised breach
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A protected inside stores heart, weapon, secret, or corruption, and may present a misleading outer face.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: hidden heart and inward matter `quranic:root_000266:B010/m01`; rhetorical cover that displays other than intended `quranic:root_001642:B005/m01`; private interior `quranic:root_000464:B003/m01`; concealed corruption `quranic:root_000464:B004/m01`; interlocking internal parts `quranic:root_000464:B008/m01`; denial covering truth `quranic:root_001307:B003/m01`; confused intermixture `quranic:root_001423:B009/m01`; concealed sword or calamity `quranic:root_000819:B005/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Interior is morally neutral until its contents are known: heart, interlocked structure, weapon, and corruption can all sit behind a cover. Disguise occurs when the outer surface asserts protection while the inner assembly carries breach.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P2 70:19-44] Joint, Support, and the Upright Load
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A stable order depends on fitted joints and upright supports that distribute weight without opening a dangerous gap.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Hip socket, interlocked flesh, shoe straps, rib cage, chest, table leg, well apparatus, straight path, exact weight, crossbeam, and exhausted support form one structural field.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Fitted joints around a gap
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Separate components meet at seams and joints, leaving controlled openings while forming a load-bearing body.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: fitting joint or socket `quranic:root_000347:B011/m01`; interlocking tissue and joints `quranic:root_000464:B008/m01`; paired straps and joined parts `quranic:root_001198:B010/m01`; opening between components `quranic:root_001139:B001/m01`; stitched panels `quranic:root_000121:B006/m01`; rib-cage bones `quranic:root_000266:B016/m01`; chest flesh `quranic:root_000095:B003/m01`; chest as structural front `quranic:root_001315:B007/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Stability is not seamlessness. Socket, seam, strap, rib, and chest permit distinct pieces to move together while controlling their gaps. Guarding an aperture is thus analogous to maintaining a joint: openness is functional only when its boundary remains fitted.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P2 70:19-44] Joint, Support, and the Upright Load
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A stable order depends on fitted joints and upright supports that distribute weight without opening a dangerous gap.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: A crossbeam converts transverse placement into useful support, but overload turns the same transverse relation into cutting. Fatigue dulls the bearing member until standing becomes immobility rather than strength.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P2 70:19-44] Food, Fire, and the Throat of Processing
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Material is transformed by heat, drying, chewing, swallowing, and digestion into nourishment, residue, or injury.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Sun-curing, spark, roasting drippings, kindled fire, stirred drink, saliva, choking, esophagus, feast, and intensified grinding form one alimentary mechanism.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Mouth, esophagus, and digestible food
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Food is tasted, chewed, lubricated, swallowed through the esophagus, and judged by whether it sits easily.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: pleasant digestible food `quranic:root_001409:B003/m01`; esophagus `quranic:root_001409:B004/m01`; eating and ceremonial feeding `quranic:root_001409:B005/m01`; light digestible food `quranic:root_001410:B003/m01`; eating and feast-giving `quranic:root_001410:B004/m01`; esophageal passage `quranic:root_001410:B005/m01`; softness and refined food `quranic:root_001525:B002/m01`; intensifying an operation such as grinding `quranic:root_001525:B010/m01`; choking obstruction `quranic:root_000790:B005/m01`; flowing saliva `quranic:root_001358:B002/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Nourishment requires a continuous passage from mouth to stomach. Softness, saliva, esophagus, and digestibility maintain that route; choking reveals how a small obstruction converts desirable intake into bodily threat.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P2 70:19-44] Wound, Infection, and Bodily Burden
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A breached body can swell, suppurate, transmit harm, and lose the alignment needed for free movement.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Incision, boil, lung disease, facial palsy, spreading wound, transmitted illness, chest frame, long neck, eye swelling, and overloaded limbs form a clinical scene.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Contact and transmitted affliction
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Harm reaches by touch, spreads from one body to another, and imposes a burden beyond ordinary capacity.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: madness-like affliction by touch `quranic:root_001423:B003/m01`; adverse impact `quranic:root_001423:B004/m01`; disease crossing between bodies `quranic:root_000993:B006/m01`; concealed internal defect `quranic:root_000464:B004/m01`; bodily disease `quranic:root_001077:B017/m01`; forced burden beyond capacity `quranic:root_000606:B003/m01`; corrupt wound spreading past its boundary `quranic:root_000138:B004/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Contact is the path by which a local defect becomes relational harm. Touch, transmission, internal concealment, and boundary-crossing explain why guarding is preventative care, while imposed burden describes the endpoint when the body can no longer contain the process.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, kalpte beliren güçlü umudu ve kişinin istediği şeye yönelmesini aynı anlam çekirdeğinde birleştirir. Verilen dal çerçevesi bu iki kurucu yönü de doğru biçimde korur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın duygu adını ve kişiyi niteleyen biçimleri kapsarken bir şeye yönelmeyi açıkça belirten kullanımı ayrı bir gerçekleşme olarak korur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi elde etmeye yönelik güçlü bir umut beslemek ve onu isteyerek ona yönelmektir. Bu yöneliş, umutsuzluğun karşıtı olan beklentiyi ve kişinin istediği şeye duyduğu çekimi birlikte içerir.

facets.statement: Kişinin kalbinde, istediği şeyi elde edebileceğine ilişkin güçlü bir umut bulunur.

Bu duygu, umutsuzluğun karşıtı olarak da sınırlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, anlamı kalpteki güçlü umut ile istenen şeye yönelik çekimin birleşmesi olarak sunar; ayrıca bu durumun umutsuzluğun karşıtı olduğunu belirtir.

concept_map.definition: Başkasında bir şeyi elde edebileceği yönünde umut ve istek uyandırmak ya da böyle bir umuda dayanak olmaktır. Bazı özel kullanımlarda kişi karşılık vermeden bu umudu besler veya yumuşak sözüyle kötü niyetli birinin kendisinden beklentiye girmesine yol açar.

facets.statement: Bir kişi veya etken, başkasında istenen şeyi elde etme umudu ve isteği uyandırır.
Umut bağlanan ve elde edilmesi beklenen şey de bu anlam alanındaki bir adla belirtilir.
Özel bir kişi nitelemesi, karşılık vermediği hâlde başkasında istek ve umut uyandıran kişiyi anlatır.
Yumuşak ve boyun eğer gibi söylenen söz, kötü niyetli dinleyicide uygunsuz bir beklenti doğurabilir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Umut uyandırma söz dışındaki yollarla da gerçekleşebilir ve umut bağlanan nesneyi de kapsayabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Çekirdek, konuşmanın yumuşak ve boyun eğer nitelikte oluşudur.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalında belirleyici olan dinleyicide elde etme umudunun doğmasıdır. Komşu dal konuşmanın biçimini anlatır; böyle bir beklenti yalnızca olası sonucudur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Umut uyandırma dürüst bir vaat veya nesnenin çekiciliğiyle de olabilir; aldatma şart değildir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kişiyi aldatmayla yanlışa veya suça sürükleme kurucu unsurdur.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da bir kişi, başkasında sonuç elde edebileceği düşüncesini doğurarak onun yönelişini etkileyebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalı elde etme umudunun uyandırılmasına dayanır ve aldatma gerektirmez. Komşu dalın çekirdeği ise yanıltarak kişiyi sakıncalı bir eyleme sürüklemektir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; iç durum, yumuşak söz ve aldatıcı yönlendirmeyle kurulan üç karşılaştırma dalın neden genel kışkırtma sayılamayacağını en açık biçimde gösterir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tekil ve çoğul biçimleriyle askerlere verilen geçim payını açıkça tanımlar. Dal çerçevesi bu kurumsal ödeme anlamını iç duygu anlamlarından doğru biçimde ayırır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal, askerlere ayrılan geçim payı veya ödenekle sınırlıdır; genel geçim kaynağına ya da kişinin umut ve isteğine yayılmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın biçimlerde tanıklanan asker ödeneği anlamını bağımsız bir dal olarak korur ve başka dallardaki duygu ya da ettirgen kullanımları içeri almaz.

concept_map.definition: Yönetici tarafından askerlere ayrılıp verilen geçim payı veya ödenektir. Tekil biçim bir askerin payını, çoğul biçim askerlerin paylarını belirtir.

facets.statement: Bir yönetici, askerlerin geçimi için onlara belirli paylar veya ödenekler verir.
Tekil biçim bir askere düşen payı, çoğul biçim ise askerlerin paylarını topluca gösterebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, bu anlamı askerlerin yöneticiden aldıkları geçim payları olarak ortak biçimde tanımlar ve tekil biçimin bir payı gösterebildiğini belirtir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Askerlere yönetim tarafından ayrılan geçimlik payın veya ödeneğin tekili ve çoğulu için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Alıcının asker oluşunu, payın geçim amacı taşımasını ve yönetimce verilmesini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Payın para veya resmî ödeme olarak düşünüldüğü bağlamlarda kısa ve doğal bir karşılıktır.

error_profile.loses: Geçim payının para dışındaki biçimlerde verilebilmesi olasılığını daraltır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Çoğul biçimin bir asker topluluğuna dağıtılan payları anlattığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

Bir kurum veya yönetim tarafından düzenli biçimde verilen ödeme düşüncesini korur.
error_profile.adds: Sivil çalışanlara verilen ücretler dâhil her türlü düzenli iş ödemesini kapsar.
error_profile.collision: Güncel dilde genel çalışan ücreti anlamıyla kolayca karışır.

error_profile.collision: Belirlenmiş yiyecek miktarı anlamıyla sınırlanır.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir ya da iki payı ve bir topluluğun ödeneğini teslim alması eylemini de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da askerlere geçimleri için verilen payı ve bunun tekil ya da çoğul miktarlarını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Payın kendisi söz konusu olduğunda iki dal büyük ölçüde örtüşür. Komşu dal ayrıca payın miktarını ve askerlerin onu alma eylemini kapsadığı için sınırı biraz daha geniştir.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Karşılıksız armağanları, kayıtlı ödemeleri ve asker dışındaki kişilere ayrılan payları da kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Yönetimce askerlere belirlenmiş bir ödeme ayrıldığı durumda iki dal aynı olayı adlandırabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalı askerlerin geçim payıyla sınırlıdır. Komşu dal ise belirlenmiş veya kayda geçirilmiş her türlü armağan ve ödeneği içine alan daha geniş bir alandır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Ödeme askerlik konumuna ve askerlerin geçimine bağlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Ödeme, asker olsun olmasın bir çalışanın yaptığı işin ücreti olarak verilir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalında ödeme asker topluluğuna ayrılan geçim payıdır. Komşu dalda belirleyici ilişki, çalışanın yaptığı iş ile bunun karşılığında aldığı ücrettir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tamamı değerlendirildi; asker geçimliği, belirlenmiş ödeme ve iş ücretiyle yapılan üç karşılaştırma bu özel kurumsal anlamın sınırını yeterince açıklar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin çoğu, özel bir kalıpla bir kişinin çok şey ummasına şaşmayı bildirir; ancak bir tanıklık aynı biçimi kişinin çok şey umar duruma gelmesi şeklinde haber veren kullanım olarak açıklar. Dal bu ikinci, ünlem dışı yoğunlaşma kullanımını da bağımlı bir yön olarak korumalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalın umutlu isteme değildir; yalnızca çokluk derecesini ünlemle vurgulayan veya kişinin bu dereceye geldiğini bildiren özel biçimlerle sınırlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnızca tanıklanan ünlem ve yoğunlaşma kalıplarına bağlanır; bu kalıpların çokluk anlamı yalın duygu adına aktarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Belirli kalıplarda, bir kimsenin bir şeyi umutla istemesinin şaşırtıcı derecede çok olduğunu bildirir. Bir kullanım ünlem kurarken başka bir kullanım kişinin çok şey umar duruma geldiğini haber verir.

facets.statement: Özel ünlem kalıbı, bir kişinin çok şey ummasını şaşkınlıkla vurgular.
Özel yüklem kullanımı, kişinin çok şey umar duruma geldiğini bildirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar özel biçimin isteğin çokluğunu vurguladığında birleşir; aktarımların bir bölümü bunu şaşma ünlemi, bir bölümü ise kişinin çok şey umar duruma gelmesi olarak açıklar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak anlatımı, keskinlik veya iş görme gücünün azalmasıyla insanın, hayvanın, rüzgarın ve duyuların yorulmasını aynı çekirdekte toplar. Verilen dal bu ortak güçten düşme sınırını doğru biçimde yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal bütünlük bildiren kullanımları ve mirasla ilgili akrabalık anlamını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın güçten düşme anlamını kapsar; bineği yorma anlamı ise yalnız belirtilen ettirgen söz öbeğine bağlıdır.

concept_map.definition: Bir insanın, hayvanın, aracın, organın ya da etkin gücün keskinliğini, dayanma gücünü veya iş görme yetisini yitirerek körelmesi ya da yorulmasıdır. Bineği bu duruma düşürme, ayrıca belirli bir ettirgen söz öbeğinde anlatılır.

facets.statement: Keskinliğin, gücün veya iş görme yetisinin azalması temel anlamdır.
Yürüyen insanın ya da hayvanın yorulması ve kılıç, dil, bakış, işitme veya rüzgarın etkisizleşmesi bu çekirdeğin gerçekleşmeleridir.
Belirli ettirgen söz öbeği, kişinin bineğini yorup güçten düşürmesini anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, yorulma ile keskinliğini veya etkinliğini yitirmeyi ortak bir güçten düşme alanında birleştirir; kullanım insan, hayvan, kılıç, dil, bakış, işitme ve rüzgar gibi farklı taşıyıcılara uzanır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Keskinlik, dayanma gücü veya etkinlik kaybının birlikte anlatıldığı dal çekirdeğine uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Hem körelmeyi hem de yorularak güçten düşmeyi korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İnsan veya hayvanın yürüme ve çalışma sonucu güçten düştüğü bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Canlı taşıyıcının yorulma ve güç kaybını eksiksiz korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kılıç, dil, bakış veya başka bir etkin yetinin keskinliğini yitirdiği bağlamlara uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Keskinlik ve etkinlik kaybını doğal bir Türkçe karşılıkla korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kılıç, dil, duyu ve rüzgar gibi taşıyıcılarda keskinlik veya etkinlik kaybını da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da yürüme sonucunda insanın veya hayvanın yorulup güçten düşmesini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal bedensel yorgunlukla sınırlıyken bu dal, aynı güç kaybını araçların keskinliği ile dilin ve duyuların etkinliğine de taşır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kılıç, dil ve rüzgarın etkisizleşmesi bu dalda açıkça yer alır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Gücün tümüyle tükenmesi, bıkkınlık ve eldekinin bitmesi komşu dalın ek kapsamıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal yorgunluk, bakışın zayıflaması ve gücün kesilmesi alanında örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal körelme ile yorulmayı geniş bir taşıyıcı dizisine uygular; komşu dal ise tükenme, kesilme ve bıkkınlık sonucunu daha belirgin kılar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tümü değerlendirildi; yalnız bedensel yorgunluk ve güç tükenmesiyle gerçek anlam örtüşmesi kuran iki komşu yayımlandı, aynı kökün öteki eşsesli dalları ayrım sağlamadığı için alınmadı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه كلال السيف واللسان والطرف والسمع والبصر، وإعياء الماشي والبعير والراحلة والريح
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الكُلّ بمعنى الإحاطة ولا الكَلالة في الميراث
branches.source_phrase_ar: خلاف الحدة وكل السيف واللسان والطرف (maqayis)؛ الكليل السيف الذي لا حد له ولسان كليل والكال المعيي (ayn)؛ كللت من المشي وكل السيف والريح والطرف واللسان (sihah)؛ الكليل السيف ولسان كليل والكال المعيي وثقل سمعه وكل بصره (tahdhib)؛ كل الرجل في مشيته والسيف عن ضريبته واللسان عن الكلام (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, başkasının bakımına ve geçimine yük olan kişiyi çekirdek yapar; yetim, yakın desteği bulunmayan kişi ve bakmakla yükümlü olunan kimse bu alanda sayılır. Dal kullanılabilir, ancak bütün bu kişileri özleri gereği değersizleştiren bir niteleme gibi okunmamalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Buradaki ağırlık fiziksel ağırlık değil, bir başkasının üstlendiği bakım ve geçim yüküdür.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın ad bağımlı kişiyi veya yükü bildirir; akrabaların kişiye yük olması gibi okumalar yalnız verilen söz öbeklerine bağlı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bakımı, geçimi veya taşınması başkasının sorumluluğuna yük olan kişi ya da şeydir. Yetim, çocuğu bulunmayan kişi veya hem çocuğu hem de ebeveyni bulunmayan kişi gibi geleneksel adlandırmalar ile akrabaların birine bağımlı hale gelmesi bu çekirdeğe bağlı özel kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Bir kişi ya da şeyin bakım, geçim veya taşıma bakımından başkasına yük olması çekirdektir.
Yetim, çocuğu bulunmayan kişi veya hem çocuğu hem ebeveyni bulunmayan kişi kanıta bağlı özel referanslardır.
Taşınan tapınma nesnesi ve geçimi bir kişiye kalan akrabalar, bağımlılık ilişkisinin söz öbeğine bağlı örnekleridir.
Kaynak anlatımında ağır tabiatlı kişi ve başkası adına iş gören kişi de bu adlandırmanın çevresinde anılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak çekirdek, geçimi veya bakımı bir başkasının üzerinde kalan bağımlı kişi ya da şeydir. Yetim, çocuğu bulunmayan kişi ve hem çocuğu hem ebeveyni bulunmayan kişi öne çıkan özel durumlar, taşınan nesne ile geçimi üstlenilen akrabalar ise ilişkiyi somutlaştıran kullanımlardır. Bir kaynak, ağır tabiatlı kişiyi ve başkası adına iş gören kişiyi de bu adlandırma çevresinde anar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Geçim, bakım veya taşıma sorumluluğunun başka bir kişiye düştüğü çekirdek ilişkiye uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Bağımlı olan tarafı ve yükü üstlenen başka tarafı birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kimsenin geçimini sağlamak zorunda olduğu aile veya yakınlar için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Bakım sorumluluğunu ve bağımlı kişiler topluluğunu açıkça korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yetim veya doğrudan aile desteğinden yoksun kişi için açıklayıcı bağlamlarda kullanılabilir.

error_profile.preserves: Kişinin yakın desteğinden yoksun olma özelliğini korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: bakımı ve geçimi sahibine yük olan
yetim veya yakın aile desteği bulunmayan kişi
sahibinin taşıdığı, ona yük olan tapınma nesnesi
yakınlarının geçim yükünü üstlenir duruma gelmek

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bakımı üstlenilen kişi veya taşınan şey, yükün kendisi olarak adlandırılır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal günah, ağır sözleşme ve üstlenilmiş soyut sorumluluğu da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal bir kişinin üzerinde kalan ve onu ağırlaştıran yük ilişkisini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal bakım ve geçimde bağımlı olan kişiyi ya da şeyi öne çıkarır; komşu dal ise taşınan somut veya soyut yükün kendisini adlandırır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bağımlı kişilerin geçim yükü ve bu yükü taşıyanla ilişkisi anlatılır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Aile için yapılan harcamanın artırılması ve geçimin genişletilmesi anlatılır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal aile bireylerinin geçimini sağlama senaryosunda buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal kimin başkasının bakımına bağımlı olduğunu belirtir; komşu dal ise bakımı üstlenen kişinin harcamayı genişletme eylemidir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar karşılaştırıldı; bakım yüküyle doğrudan sınır paylaşan ve aynı geçim senaryosunu aydınlatan iki komşu seçildi, öteki adaylar farklı eylem ve eşsesli anlamlardır.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الكُلّ بمعنى العيال والثقل، واليتيم، ومن لا ولد له، وما يكون عالة على غيره
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الكُلّ الذي يفيد الإحاطة ولا الكَلالة بوصفها حكما في الورثة
branches.source_phrase_ar: الكُلّ العيال واليتيم (maqayis)؛ الكل اليتيم والكل الرجل الذي لا ولد له والكل أيضا الذي هو عيال وثقل (ayn)؛ الكل العيال والثقل والكل اليتيم والكل الذي لا ولد له ولا والد (sihah)؛ الكل الثقيل الروح واليتيم والوكيل والذي هو عيال وثقل على صاحبه (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, parçaları veya bireyleri eksiksiz kapsayan ve biçimce tekil olsa da toplu anlam veren belirleyiciyi açıkça tanımlar. Dalın bütünlük ve tamlık çerçevesi bu dilbilgisel çekirdeğe uygundur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal bir şeyin olgunlaşıp tamamlanma sürecini değil, var olan bütünün eksiksiz kapsamını bildirir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnız yalın kapsam belirleyicisini açıklar; belirli kalıplardan yeni bir temel anlam çıkarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir bütünün parçalarını ya da bir kümenin bireylerini eksiksiz biçimde kapsayan, biçimce tekil olsa da toplu anlam verebilen belirleyicidir.

facets.statement: Bir şeyin parçalarının veya bir kümedeki bireylerin hiçbirini dışarıda bırakmadan kapsanması çekirdektir.
Sözcük biçimce tekil kullanılırken anlamca bir topluluğun tamamına yönelebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, sözcüğün parçaları bir araya getirerek tam kapsam verdiğinde ve tekil biçimle topluluğun bütününü gösterdiğinde birleşir. Bir kaynak, sözcüğü daima tamlanan olarak kullanılan bir kapsam adı şeklinde sınırlar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Parçaların veya bireylerin eksiksiz kapsamını bildiren yalın belirleyici için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Eksiksiz kapsamı ve bütünlük anlamını doğal Türkçe belirleyicilerle korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Tek bir şeyin bütün parçalarının birlikte kastedildiği adlaşmış bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bir şeyin hiçbir parçasını dışarıda bırakmayan tam kapsamı korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Her büyüklükteki kümenin veya bir nesnenin parçalarının tamamını kapsayabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kapsamı özellikle iki öğeyle sınırlıdır ve iki ayrı biçimle kurulur.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal belirtilen kümedeki öğeleri eksiksiz kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal sayı bakımından genel bir bütünlük belirleyicisidir; komşu dal yalnız iki öğenin ikisini birden kapsayan özel belirleyicileri anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Var olan parçaların veya bireylerin eksiksiz olarak kapsama alınmasını bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir şeyin gelişip tamamlanması, eksikliğinin giderilmesi veya olgun duruma erişmesi de anlatılır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal eksiksizlik ve tam olma düşüncesinde buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal nicel kapsam kuran bir belirleyicidir; komşu dal ise bir şeyin tamam olma durumu ile tamamlanma eylemini de içerir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tamamı incelendi; sayı bakımından özel kapsam ile tamamlanma durumunu ayıran iki komşu yararlı bulundu, deyimsel bütünlük anlatımları çekirdeği ayrıca keskinleştirmedi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه لفظ الكُلّ لضم الأجزاء وإحاطة الشيء أو الذوات، ومعنى التمام في كل البسط ونحوه
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الكُلّ بمعنى العيال والثقل ولا كلال القوة والحدة
branches.source_phrase_ar: كل اسم موضوع للإحاطة مضاف أبدا (maqayis)؛ كل لفظه واحد ومعناه جمع (sihah)؛ يقع كل على اسم منكور موحد فيؤدي معنى الجماعة وكلهم للإحاطة (tahdhib)؛ لفظ كل هو لضم أجزاء الشيء ويفيد معنى التمام (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, ana baba ve çocuk dışındaki mirasçı yakınları, uzak soy bağını ve doğrudan değil yan koldan geçen mirası birlikte verir. Dal doğru yöndedir; ancak adın ölen kişi, mirasçı topluluğu, akrabalık türü veya miras ilişkisinin kendisi için kullanılabildiği açık tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Ana baba ile çocuk bu sınıfın dışındadır; olumsuz söz öbeği ise yan koldan değil doğrudan hakla miras almayı bildirir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yan kol akrabalığı çekirdeğini korur; doğrudan miras ve uzak kuzenlik okumaları kendi söz öbeklerine bağlıdır.

concept_map.definition: Ana baba ve çocuk dışındaki, özellikle uzak veya yan koldaki yakınlar üzerinden kurulan mirasçılık ve akrabalık ilişkisidir. Ad, böyle bir miras bırakan kişi, bu yolla mirasçı olanlar veya ilişkinin kendisi için kullanılabilir.

facets.statement: Doğrudan üstsoy ve altsoy dışında kalan yan kol veya uzak akrabalık temel sınırdır.
Ad, ana babası ve çocuğu bulunmadan ölen kişiye, onun yan kol mirasçılarına veya bu miras biçimine yönelebilir.
Olumsuz miras söz öbeği doğrudan hakla miras almayı, kuzenlik söz öbeği ise uzak akrabalığı belirtir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım ana baba ve çocuk dışındaki mirasçı yakınları, uzak kuzenleri ve yan koldan geçen mirası bir araya getirir. Sözcüğün ölen kişiye mi, mirasçılara mı, akrabalığa mı yoksa mirasa mı yöneldiği bağlama göre değişebilir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Ana baba ve çocuk dışındaki yakınlar üzerinden kurulan miras ilişkisini açıklamak için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Dışlanan doğrudan soy çizgisini ve yan kol mirasçılığını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Ana baba veya çocuk olmayan uzak bir yakının mirasçı olduğu bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Mirasçının doğrudan soy çizgisi dışında bulunmasını açıkça korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yakın kuzen olmayan, soy bağı daha uzaktan kurulan kuzen için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Kuzenlik bağının doğrudan ve yakın olmayan derecesini korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: ana baba ve çocuk dışındaki yan kol mirasçılığı
yan koldan değil, doğrudan hakla miras almak

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Akrabalığı ana baba ve çocuk dışındaki yan kollara ve miras bağlamına sınırlar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Her türlü kan ve soy yakınlığını, doğrudan üstsoy ile altsoyu da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal insanlar arasındaki soy bağını ve yakınlık derecesini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal miras bağlamında doğrudan üstsoy ve altsoyu dışarıda bırakan özel bir akrabalık sınıfıdır; komşu dal soy yakınlığının tamamını kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Mirasçının doğrudan soy çizgisi dışında bulunma koşulunu öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Malın ölen kişiden herhangi bir yasal veya soy temelli mirasçıya geçmesi olayını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal ölen kişiden kalan malın yakınlara geçmesi alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal belirli bir akraba ve mirasçı sınıfını sınırlar; komşu dal ise mirasın kaynaktan mirasçıya geçmesi olayının genel adıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel akrabalık ve genel miras aktarımı en açıklayıcı iki sınırı verdi, öteki adaylar özel miras hükümleri veya yalnız aynı aile alanındaki uzak konulardır.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الكَلالة للميت أو الوارث أو القرابة التي عدا الوالد والولد، وبنو العم الأباعد، والميراث من عرض لا من قرب مباشر
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الولد والوالد، ولا الإرث عن قرب واستحقاق مباشر
branches.source_phrase_ar: الكلالة هم الرجال الورثة وبنو العم الأباعد ومن مات وليس له ولد ولا والد (maqayis)؛ الكل النسب البعيد (ayn)؛ لم يرثه كلالة أي لم يرثه عن عرض والكلالة بنو العم الأباعد (sihah)؛ الكلالة من القرابة ما خلا الوالد والولد (tahdhib)؛ الكلالة اسم لما عدا الولد والوالد من الورثة (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, bir şeyin başı veya çevresi boyunca kuşatıcı biçimde yer alan nesne ve görünümleri ortaklaştırır. Baş çevresindeki süslü kuşak, gök konumu, çevreleyen bulut ve kenarı çiçek ya da küçük bulutlarla sarılı yer bu çekirdeğin destekli uzantılarıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, çevreleme biçimini temel alır; dikilmiş koruyucu perde veya genel bütünlük belirleyicisi değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın adın çevreleyen nesne anlamları korunur; çiçekle veya bulut parçalarıyla çevrilme yalnız verilen niteleme kalıplarına bağlanır.

concept_map.definition: Bir başın, yerin ya da göksel görünümün çevresini kuşak gibi saran veya kenarlarını belirginleştiren nesne ve oluşumdur. Süslü baş kuşağı, belirli bir gök konumu, çevreleyen bulut ve çiçek ya da küçük bulutlarla çevrilmiş görünüm bu çekirdeğin özel gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Bir şeyin çevresini kuşak gibi sarma veya kenarını çevreleyerek belirginleştirme çekirdektir.
Süslü baş kuşağı veya taç ile belirli bir gök konumu, yalın adın özel karşılıklarıdır.
Bir yeri dolaşan bulut ya da başka bir örtümsü bulut görünümü çevreleme çekirdeğinin göğe uzanmasıdır.
Çiçeklerle çevrili çayır ve çevresinde küçük bulut parçaları bulunan bulut, belirli niteleme kalıplarıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar başı saran süslü kuşağı, belirli gök konumunu ve çevreleme biçimi gösteren bulut ile çayır tasvirlerini aynı çevresini sarma düşüncesinde toplar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Baş, yer veya göksel görünüm çevresinde kuşatıcı bir sınır oluşturan dal çekirdeğine uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Çevreleme ilişkisini ve kuşak biçimli görünümü birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Başı çevreleyen süslü kuşak veya değerli taşlarla bezeli başlık bağlamına uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Başı saran süslü başlık anlamını doğal ve kısa biçimde korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Ana bulutun çevresinde daha küçük bulut parçalarının bulunduğu görünüm için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Merkezdeki bulutu ve onu çevreleyen parçaları birlikte korur.

bir yerin çevresini dolaşan örtümsü bulut

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Süslü baş kuşağı, belirli gök konumu ve bulut çevrelenmesi gibi özel adlandırmaları kapsar.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الإكليل، وإطافة الشيء بالرأس أو بالمكان، ومنزل القمر، والسحاب المحيط، والروضة المحفوفة بالنور، والسحاب المكلل بالقطع
